lines.t: Quiet the soul
Quiet the soul
Set the heart apart
A higher way
A truer start
God desires a heart made clean
Not divided, drifting, unseen
A life that seeks what truly stays
And walks away from empty ways
He calls the willing to draw near
To leave behind the shallow and unclear
To turn from what corrupts the mind
And seek what is holy, true, and kind
First surrender, then obey
They step by step along the way, the way of purity begins in humility, lay down pride
And choose the pure
Let the steady path endure
Guard the thoughts, watch the tongue
Let truth be lived and not just sung
In small obedience we grow
Into the heart he longs to know
Purity is not a claim, it is a daily faithful frame
A choosing of the better part, a cleansing of the inner heart
It starts with honesty and prayer, with open hands and humble care
With eyes that turn from what deceives and ears that listen, hearts that believe
Every secret brought to light
Helps the soul be made right
The way of purity
Begins in humility
Let our pride and choose the pure
Let the steady path endure
Guard the thoughts, watch the tongue
Let truth be lived in, not just some
In small obedience we grow
Into the heart he longs to know
So make the hidden places clean
When no one else has ever seen
Let repentance do its work
Let the old self lose its curse
Receive the grace to start again
Walk in peace and not in vain
For purity is not the game
It is a heart that bears his name
Surrender
Repent
Guard the mind
Walk in truth
Stay the course
Be made new
The way of purity
Begins in humility
Lay down pride and choose the pure
Let the steady path endure
Guard the thoughts, watch the tongue
Let truth be lifted, not just some
In small obedience we grow
Into the heart he longs to know
Quiet the soul
Oh, set the heart apart
A higher way
A truer start
